items.title: 'Wildwood' Director Hopes People "See The Danger" In GenAI, Calls It "Antithetical" To Laika's Work
items.excerpt: As Laika debuts its stop-motion feature 'Wildwood', director and Laika CEO Travis Knight stands firmly against generative AI, calling it antithetical to the studio's handmade craft.

items.title: 'The Hunger Games' Producer Nina Jacobson Talks Using AI to Test ADR Lines Before Recording with Actors
items.excerpt: Producer Nina Jacobson explains how 'Sunrise on the Reaping' used AI voices in post to audition ADR lines before bringing actors in to record them.

items.title: Stage 32 Launches Marketplace To Combat AI Slop
items.excerpt: The Stage 32 writing platform has launched a vetted marketplace to counter an influx of AI-generated scripts and project submissions.

items.title: Lorem Ipsum Rap | F&C ai Lab
items.excerpt: Francois Chatelain, working solo as F&C ai Lab, made an AI-generated hip-hop video around 'Lorem Ipsum' placeholder text, using Suno for music, Midjourney for illustrations and Seedance for the animated sequences.

items.title: 'Nothing Hides on a Cinema Screen': Jo Plaete Talks Brahma AI's Emmy-Winning Face Replacement Tech
items.excerpt: Brahma AI's co-founder and CTO discusses the Neural Performance face-replacement technology that shared a 2026 Technology & Engineering Emmy with Disney Research, Digital Domain and Rising Sun Pictures.

items.title: The Concept Art Awards: Blind Judging by Peers and No AI Allowed
items.excerpt: The Concept Art Awards' co-founders explain why their peer-judged show for film and game concept artists bars AI-generated work.

items.title: Gossip Goblin's AI Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Picked Up by AGC Intl.
items.excerpt: AGC Intl., Stuart Ford's sales arm, adds the AI-rendered sci-fi feature by YouTuber Gossip Goblin to its AFM slate ahead of a December US theatrical release.

items.title: Sylvester Stallone Defends AI: "It's Happening, Go With It Or Be Trampled"
items.excerpt: After backlash over his pitch for a 'half human, half AI' Rambo movie, Stallone says the industry must embrace AI because it is 'here to stay.'

items.title: Gen Z Feels 'Doomed' Watching AI, but Gen Alpha Feels Differently
items.excerpt: A study finds over 30 percent of young viewers feel 'doomed' or 'scared' watching AI-generated content, with sharp differences between Gen Z and Gen Alpha.

items.title: Tsui Hark Pays Emotional Tribute to Nansun Shi, Discusses New Projects and Reflects on AI at Lumiere Festival
items.excerpt: At Lumiere, Tsui Hark discusses new projects including a dreamlike future city and the growing challenges filmmakers face in the age of AI.

items.title: Joseph Gordon-Levitt Says Instead of Being Afraid of AI, "We Should Be Concerned About the People Building AI"
items.excerpt: Gordon-Levitt argues the risk lies with AI companies training models on creators' work and designing them to 'hijack your intimacy.'

items.title: Hollywood AI-listers: is the technology ready to rival flesh-and-blood film stars?
items.excerpt: With an AI Val Kilmer starring in a new western and synthetic starlet Tilly Norwood set for her feature debut, experts split on how soon AI actors go mainstream.

items.title: China's first fully AI-generated feature film to hit cinemas on Friday
items.excerpt: Bona Film Group's 'Sanxingdui', China's first fully AI-generated feature to receive a theatrical release permit, opens in cinemas this Friday as a test for the industry.

items.title: AI로 10시간 만에 만든 한국 애니메이션, 美영화제서 '특별언급상' 수상
items.excerpt: '승리호' 제작에 참여한 홍정민 감독이 AI로 10시간 만에 만든 90초 단편 애니메이션 '스티칭 하트'가 미국 일루미네이트 영화제에서 특별언급상을 받았다.

items.title: 'Paper Tiger' director James Gray says AI isn't a threat to the creative community
items.excerpt: At the Sao Paulo festival James Gray argued AI cannot replace 'the struggle for the human heart' at the core of filmmaking.

items.title: Hollywood Animation Directors On Distribution, Sequels, And AI
items.excerpt: At View Conference, directors of 'GOAT', 'Forgotten Island' and 'Toy Story 5' discussed the box office and, unavoidably, generative AI in animation pipelines.

items.title: This FREE AI Previz Tool is Awesome & a Secret Video Model!
items.excerpt: A free open-source previz tool that locks the exact shot before AI video generation, a fix for stiff 3D-guided AI video, and the anonymous 'Iron Goddess' video model surfacing in Arena blind tests.

items.title: ByteDance's World Model Re-Shoots Movies, Sora Returns? & Krea 3 Is Here!
items.excerpt: ByteDance's unreleased world model re-shot a scene from Stephen Chow's 'King of Comedy' from new camera angles off one drawn path; plus Krea 3 beta, OmniHuman 2.0 and LTX-2.5 post tools.
